source_symbols.rust_mapping: Checked add/multiply operations protect target spans, table ranges, capacities, and allocation-byte calculations.
WorkControl charges actual loop work and a checked 50,000,000 local work ceiling stops excess traversal.
apply_value checks the target span and every checked source transform ancestor against the active target range.
apply_value distinguishes the exact element or immediate source transform target from descendants.
Transform overlays resolve source-offset nodes and test each instance shape ancestry before applying its matrix.
has_effect rejects geometry animation when the shape belongs to a filtered or masked opacity group.
product composes attribute, suffix, and motion across root-to-instance ancestry with the 128-node cap.
Opacity and stroke opacity clamp to [0,1] before legacy round-half-up byte conversion.
Frame inverse retains the 1e-15 determinant threshold and checks the finite resulting affine.
translate/scale/rotate/skew matrices preserve SVG coefficient order and rotation-center composition; focused math tests cover each family.
Transform/motion deltas map all actual edge endpoints and update embedded stroke plus fill/stroke paint inverses.
Numeric X/Y/center/size/radius tracks map only the selected shape edge range with checked work and valid geometry.
shape_bounds maps every edge endpoint through the current world inverse and rejects malformed or empty ranges.
Numeric geometry overlays refresh object-box linear/radial fill-paint bounds; real scene tests assert the updated rectangle bounds.
X/Y and width/height/radius-family matrices preserve scaling anchors, current world conjugation, and unsupported limits.
Active transform/motion items apply in overlay order to instance shapes, edges, stroke/paint inverses, and the owned clip overlay.
Active color/opacity/stroke/geometry attributes update effective tables; unsupported values return diagnostics without static fallback.
The frame API returns the real owned evaluated frame. Raster dispatch remains a later DecodeOperations/KernelResources/FlatKernel/native-provider adapter.
Checked arithmetic computes estimated nested clip bytes and every actual capacity byte total.
try_reserve_exact is preceded by the frozen 64 MiB estimate; actual Vec capacities are checked before returning the clone.
Scene ClipId records provide one graph-owned clip identity shared across shape references; no pointer hash table is needed.
Opaque checked ClipId identity replaces raw-pointer hashing; a real two-shape shared-ClipId scene verifies alias preservation.
Rust Vec ownership drops temporary clip and nested geometry buffers on every error path; no manual release/refcount callback.
The entire ClipId-indexed table and nested edge/child vectors are fallibly copied once per evaluated overlay and preserved by identity.
Clip traversal charges ClipChain/ClipEdge/ClipChild work and checks the 50,000,000 local ceiling.
Clip inversion accepts finite nonzero determinants, then validates the inverse affine, matching the clip-specific zero threshold.
Full products and target products before the target suffix are kept separately and used for actual owner modes.
Effective shape transform ancestry uses checked TransformIds, the 128-depth bound, and charged work.
All effective owner-chain shapes and current edge endpoints contribute bounds after the target full inverse.
Each shape clip-root/parent chain updates matching owners, inverse mode, and valid object-box bounds with depth 64.
Public update_animation_clips clones, updates the full instance ancestry, and atomically publishes through finished-frame replace_clips.

operations.name: evaluate_frame
operations.signature: fn evaluate_frame<'a>(view: SceneView<'a>, time_seconds: f64, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<EvaluatedFrame<'a>>; fn update_animation_clips(frame: &mut EvaluatedFrame<'_>, shape: ShapeId, update_bounds: bool, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<()>
operations.implementation: evaluate_frame evaluates existing DocumentView overlays and publishes only changed owned tables. Real owned-scene tests cover active geometry/color/opacity/transform/motion, paint bounds/inverses, nested owner-before-suffix clips, shared ClipId aliases, zero-edge IDs, repeated-frame immutability, limits and rollback. update_animation_clips performs a real checked-ID operation with finished-frame atomic replacement. raster dispatch is handed to the later actual runtime adapters.
operations.contract: Current accepted APIs replace the historical proposal spelling: SceneView all-record handles, SceneGraph scene_id, actual SceneBuilder append-time ownership, current effective references, full active overlay order, exact supported/unsupported animation behavior, owner-before-suffix matrices, actual-capacity clip clones, and atomic configured-budget overlap validation.
